en-US.title: CLT - Charlotte Guide
en-US.subtitle: Greenways, Deals & Parking
en-US.description:
Discover Charlotte like a local. CLT is a free, open-source guide to the Queen City covering three essentials:

GREENWAYS
Browse all 63 Mecklenburg County greenway trails with distances, surface types, and real-time status. Sort by proximity to find the closest trail to you.

DAILY DEALS
Find today's happy hour specials and restaurant deals across Charlotte. Filter by day of the week to plan your outings.

PARKING
Locate street parking zones with hours, rates, and availability. Never circle the block again.

BUILT BY THE COMMUNITY
Every piece of data is community-verified. See something outdated? Submit a correction in seconds — your contribution becomes a public pull request on GitHub.

NO ACCOUNTS, NO TRACKING
CLT collects zero personal information. No logins, no analytics, no ads. Your location stays on your device and is only used to sort results by distance.

OPEN SOURCE
The entire app is open source. Read the code, suggest features, or fork it for your own city.
en-US.promotionalText: Charlotte's greenways, daily deals, and parking -- community-maintained and always free.
en-US.whatsNew: First release! Browse 63 greenway trails, discover daily restaurant deals, and find street parking across Charlotte.
